title: Staff/guest dual table QR 10/10
summary: Same printed table QR: guests use phone camera; staff scan in-app (Floor → Scan table). Shared live tickets so guests track, add more, and amend after waiter takes the order.
highlights: Floor → Scan table staff in-app QR scanner
Guest hub shows waiter-taken and guest tickets
Guest can add more and amend pending items
POS KOTs tagged as staff for shared table view
Builds on v205 + mobile menu/inventory cards
